purpose: Distinguish unwillingness to acquire economic/growth cores from inability to profit after acquisition
status: predeclared before case selection and outcomes
source_selection: natural training-source games only; seed % 5 != 0; T9-T12; core legal in shop and absent from board/hand; one earliest case per source game; deterministic identifier ordering
arms: one forced legal purchase, then same policy
current_opponents: preserve source EOT state; inject normal paired snapshots only from next turn
future_seed: 11901000 + case_index * 1000 + replicate; same per model and arm
controller: reset equally in both arms; conditional suffixes, not exact replay of original controller history
quality: all learner actions recorded; native replay 16 steps per rollout; finished rank and clean engine required
analysis: paired rank difference, case-clustered bootstrap; core play/sell/retention, EOT strength and survival recorded; no automatic labels or model promotion
engineering_probe: CPU, maximum one case per core and one replicate, parent only; validates execution before the main study; not added as independent evidence
